name: oconfig
author: Rex Zhou
description: Save Omarchy customizations into a local git repo. Checks live configs against packaged defaults, ignores machine-local files, and can restore onto a new box.

barWidget.description: Git store for Omarchy config customizations

schema.label: Git remote URL
schema.description: Optional. HTTPS or SSH URL for the config store (for example git@github.com:YOU/omarchy-config.git). Empty keeps the store local-only. Push with p, pull with u.
